profile.headline: Software Engineer at CACI International Inc
profile.summary: I am self-driven with strong communication skills and familiar with AGILE development. I graduated from Virginia Tech.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Maintained Falcon web UI which includes electronic warfare tools, radio frequency, and signal detections using AngularJS,
JS, and Groovy.
● Experienced Puppet engineer proficient in automating and managing large-scale infrastructure, ensuring configuration
consistency and deployment efficiency for complex IT environments.
● Proficient in Docker containerization and orchestration, with a focus on enhancing application deployment efficiency.
● Experienced software architect skilled in designing and implementing scalable microservices, leveraging containerization and
orchestration technologies to create distributed systems that improve agility and maintainability.
● Created a web app to monitor the stability and health of service-oriented architecture (SOA) services using technologies such
as Docker, Spring Boot, ActiveMQ, Maven, and Apache Camel.
● Utilized Spring Boot’s WebSocket to asynchronously call the SOA service to send the data.
● Developed a web app to manage multiple resources such as virtual machines and hardware within a team. Displays useful
tracking information for reservations, uptime, and usage. Utilized Java, React, Spring Boot and Bootstrap.
● Employed Agile development methodologies using Jira as our project management tool.
● Reverse engineered the SOA service to understand the requirements of its input parameters and its outputs.

positions.title: Virginia Tech Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- TA’d for intro to python class and TA’d for intro to java class.
- Hosted lab sessions where I explained technical lab specs to students in an easy to understand format.
- Held office hours where I personally assisted 10+ students each session.

company.name: Virginia Tech Department of Computer Science

positions.title: Assistant Database Administrator
positions.description:
- Develop MS-SQL scripts for merging and migrating database; tools used included Red Gate SQL, Microsoft Team Foundation and Beyond Compare
- Assisted in configuring databases for development and testing environment targeted for six clients. 
-  Interface with developers to capture requirement, design and gap analysis and enter into ticketing system called, Gemini 
- Maintain and provide daily system support including database backup, versioning and labeling, run DB profiling for performance analysis. 
-  Familiar with AGILE software development practice by participating in daily scrum and sprint planning sessions
